mentions.name: ZenQuery
mentions.description: A desktop app that lets users ask questions on their data files (CSV, JSON, Parquet, Excel) in plain English without incurring heavy LLM costs. It offers an unlimited question-answering plan for $20/month with no usage caps.
mentions.problem: Asking questions about data files using LLMs incurs heavy costs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a desktop app that lets you ask questions on your data files like csv, json, parquet and excel in plain english without incurring heavy LLM costs.
